mapper.select: select * from cost_card_version where card_id = #{cardId} order by version_no desc

insert into cost_card (scope_type, scope_id, card_code, card_name, card_type, status, effective_version_id, linked_dish_count, remark, created_by, created_at, updated_at) values (#{header.scopeType}, #{header.scopeId}, #{header.cardCode}, #{header.cardName}, #{header.cardType}, #{header.status}, #{header.effectiveVersionId}, #{header.linkedDishCount}, #{header.remark}, #{header.createdBy}, current_timestamp, current_timestamp) returning id
mapper.update: update cost_card set card_name = #{header.cardName}, card_type = #{header.cardType}, remark = #{header.remark}, updated_at = current_timestamp where id = #{header.id}
mapper.select: insert into cost_card_version (card_id, version_no, effective_date, version_status, referenced, remark, created_at, updated_at) values (#{version.cardId}, #{version.versionNo}, #{version.effectiveDate}, #{version.versionStatus}, #{version.referenced}, #{version.remark}, current_timestamp, current_timestamp) returning id
mapper.insert: insert into cost_card_line (version_id, item_code, item_name, unit_name, quantity, conversion_rate, loss_rate, default_warehouse, remark, created_at) values (#{versionId}, #{line.itemCode}, #{line.itemName}, #{line.unitName}, #{line.quantity}, #{line.conversionRate}, #{line.lossRate}, #{line.defaultWarehouse}, #{line.remark}, current_timestamp)
mapper.update: update cost_card_version set version_status = case when id = #{versionId} then 'ACTIVE' else 'DISABLED' end, updated_at = current_timestamp where card_id = #{cardId}
update cost_card set status = 'ENABLED', effective_version_id = #{versionId}, updated_at = current_timestamp where id = #{cardId}
update cost_card set status = 'DISABLED', updated_at = current_timestamp where id = #{cardId}
mapper.insert: insert into dish_cost_card_binding (scope_type, scope_id, dish_id, card_id, default_warehouse, enabled, created_at, updated_at) values (#{scopeType}, #{scopeId}, #{dishId}, #{cardId}, #{defaultWarehouse}, #{enabled}, current_timestamp, current_timestamp) on conflict (scope_type, scope_id, dish_id) do update set card_id = excluded.card_id, default_warehouse = excluded.default_warehouse, enabled = excluded.enabled, updated_at = current_timestamp
